deployments_detail.use: AI-based real-time fraud detection on the indemnification/claims platform (mass data pattern analysis), plus disclosed AI adoption across value chain; leadership-attributed

Digital Factory: dedicated in-house digital/data unit (~40 people) staffing data scientists and 'artificial intelligence specialists' alongside developers and architects to build AI/data products for the insurer's transformation. [Dovteam (consulting partner)]

Digital health-claims automation in My Wafa Sante: online claim declaration and reimbursement with AMO/RAMED coverage automatically factored in, plus digital deposit and real-time tracking of medical-expense files. [not disclosed]

Data Office structuring engagement: external partner (Seven) engaged to help structure Wafa Assurance's Data Office, the governance/foundation function underpinning its data & AI initiatives. [Seven (Digital & Data partner)]

Automated vehicle-damage analysis: AI/computer-vision assesses accident damage from customer-submitted photos and the digital e-constat (e-report) to produce an immediate estimate and settle the auto-claim file without a physical visit. Marketed as an active service in the auto-claims journey. [not disclosed]

Remote expertise (expertise a distance): auto-claim damage assessed remotely via the mobile app / photo-video rather than an in-person expert visit, part of a '100% digitalized' interconnected claims journey (mobile app, home repair, advance on repair). [not disclosed]

AI integrated into the 'Wafa Oto Sarii' auto-insurance customer journey to enable fast claim indemnification (company explicitly markets 'l'IA integree a votre parcours Wafa Oto Sarii' for rapid indemnisation). [not disclosed]

Data & AI roadmap and portfolio of internal AI use-cases: at an Oct 17, 2025 AI Day for 110+ managers/top management, Wafa Assurance presented its 'roadmap Data & IA' and 20 employee-built AI use-cases (4 singled out) applied to insurance. Indicates a portfolio of AI use-cases under development. [advisors: Artefact, Onepoint, AI Movement (per company LinkedIn)]

Connected-driving telematics in the MyWafa mobile app: analyzes driving data to alert motorists when they exceed speed limits and provides geolocated assistance on accident/breakdown ('conduite connectee'). [not disclosed]
